subject.title: feat(android): add Wear conversations, voice, agents, and sessions

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the full chat, voice, agents, and sessions Wear OS companion now, or stage Wear support through the status-only PR first?
rationale: Both branches are technically plausible, but choosing the official first-party product scope, release obligation, and acceptable phone/watch metadata boundary requires Android-owner intent rather than contributor-side implementation judgment.

options.title: Stage status-only Wear first
options.body: Land the bounded status-only path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108803, define ownership and publication, and revisit the full interaction surface as a separately sponsored phase.

options.title: Sponsor the full companion
options.body: Keep this PR as the landing path after opaque session handles, exact-head physical proof, and the Play publication and upgrade contract are completed.

options.title: Decline first-party Wear
options.body: Close the Wear PR series and avoid taking on a new official application and release surface.

recommendation.title: Stage status-only Wear first
recommendation.body: Land the bounded status-only path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108803, define ownership and publication, and revisit the full interaction surface as a separately sponsored phase.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly assigns the Android app to @obviyus, and the choice governs Android product scope and release ownership.
